Row.Text: Adds a Dam building to each age. Build it on a river tile, navigable or not; once it is finished, floods on that river stop pillaging the improvements, buildings and districts of the settlements along it: an Ancient Dam holds back moderate floods, a Medieval Dam major ones as well, and a Modern Dam every flood. The cost is the valley: the Dam holds the water back and the floodplains dry out, so the land along the river gives up that Food for good. A river takes one Dam of each age, so an old Dam can be joined by a newer one. Unlocked by Irrigation, Machinery and Electricity.

Holds back the river it stands on. Must be placed on a river tile, navigable or not. A river takes one Dam of each age. When it is finished, moderate floods on this river no longer pillage Improvements, Buildings or Districts in any [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] along it. Major and 1000-year floods still do damage. Floods still come and are still reported. The valley dries out behind it: this river loses its [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_FLOODPLAINS_TOOLTIP]Floodplains[/TIP] and the [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food they carry.
Settlements along this river are not pillaged by moderate floods. The river loses its Floodplains. One of each age per river.

Holds back the river it stands on. Must be placed on a river tile, navigable or not. A river takes one Dam of each age. When it is finished, moderate and major floods on this river no longer pillage Improvements, Buildings or Districts in any [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] along it. A 1000-year flood still does damage. Floods still come and are still reported. The valley dries out behind it: this river loses its [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_FLOODPLAINS_TOOLTIP]Floodplains[/TIP] and the [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food they carry.
Settlements along this river are not pillaged by moderate or major floods. The river loses its Floodplains. One of each age per river.

Holds back the river it stands on. Must be placed on a river tile, navigable or not. A river takes one Dam of each age. When it is finished, floods of every size, the 1000-year flood included, on this river no longer pillage Improvements, Buildings or Districts in any [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] along it. Floods still come and are still reported. The valley dries out behind it: this river loses its [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_FLOODPLAINS_TOOLTIP]Floodplains[/TIP] and the [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food they carry.
Settlements along this river are not pillaged by any flood. The river loses its Floodplains. One of each age per river.
Raised by an Ancient Dam on this settlement's river. Improvements, Buildings and Districts in this [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] are not pillaged by moderate floods.

Raised by a Medieval Dam on this settlement's river. Improvements, Buildings and Districts in this [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] are not pillaged by moderate or major floods.
Raised by a Modern Dam on this settlement's river. Improvements, Buildings and Districts in this [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] are not pillaged by floods of any size.
